work.permit: Autorización para el trabajo de adolescentes (authorisation for adolescent work)

note: Majority: the Civil Code (Decreto Legislativo 295), article 42 as worded by Law 31945 (published 25 November 2023, which also ended marriage of minors): every person over eighteen has full capacity to act; a person over sixteen with an official professional title gains capacity (article 46-A, not held). Work: the Code of Children and Adolescents (Law 27337 of 2000), article 50, an adolescent needs authorisation to work, and article 51 (as amended by Law 27571 of 2001) sets the ages for authorising it: for employment by another, fifteen in non-industrial farm work, sixteen in industrial, commercial or mining work, seventeen in industrial fishing; for every other kind of work, fourteen, and by exception from twelve where the work harms neither health nor schooling. Held as fourteen, the general floor the article names, though an employee in commerce or industry must be sixteen (not held); hours limits (article 56) are not held. Performers: the Code has no rule of its own for a child performer, so a performer under fourteen is held to the exceptional authorisation from twelve, and none below twelve: a reading. The authorisation is now given by the regional labour authority (Supreme Decree 018-2020-TR, not read here). Service: the Military Service Law (Law 29248, El Peruano 28 June 2008), article 1, regulates a voluntary military service; article 2, it is open to men and women from eighteen; article 6 forbids forced recruitment. Read by eye from the scanned gazette page. Later amendments (Legislative Decree 1146 of 2012, which provided a draw where volunteers fall short) were not read, so this rests on the 2008 text: a reading to check.

sources.title: Congreso de la República del Perú: Ley 31945, que modifica el Código Civil (texto, El Peruano 25-11-2023)
sources.said: Toda persona mayor de dieciocho años tiene plena capacidad de ejercicio.

sources.title: Gob.pe: Ley 27337, Nuevo Código de los Niños y Adolescentes (texto con modificaciones), artículos 50 y 51
sources.said: Los adolescentes requieren autorización para trabajar, salvo en el caso del trabajador familiar no remunerado. ... b) Dieciséis años para labores industriales, comerciales o mineras; y, ... 2. Para el caso de las demás modalidades de trabajo la edad mínima es de catorce años. Por excepción se concederá autorización a partir de los doce años

sources.title: Congreso de la República del Perú: Ley 29248, Ley del Servicio Militar (El Peruano, 28 de junio de 2008, scanned)
sources.said: La presente Ley tiene por objeto regular el Servicio Militar Voluntario ... Es prestado por varones y mujeres sin discriminación alguna, a partir de los dieciocho (18) años de edad. ... Prohíbese el reclutamiento forzoso como procedimiento de captación de personas con la finalidad de incorporarlas al Servicio Militar.
